name: Eden's Ritter - Bangai Hen
original_name: エデンズリッター 番外編
source:
In the Xenoarachne Defeat story, the heroines are caught like flies in the web of one of their most dangerous enemies. Her soft and silken threads draw them in ever closer, until the former heroines find themselves dancing on her strings...
